entries.meaning: Hábil, diestro (especialmente para manejar situaciones).
entries.example: She was adroit at steering the meeting away from a pointless argument.

entries.meaning: Retrospectiva: entender algo solo después de que ocurrió.
entries.example: In hindsight, waiting one more week would have been cheaper.

entries.meaning: Sesgo retrospectivo: creer que ya se sabía lo que iba a pasar.
entries.example: The hindsight bias makes old forecasts look more obvious than they were.

entries.meaning: Sopesar opciones, comparar alternativas antes de decidir.
entries.example: We weighed our options for a week before signing anything.

entries.meaning: Compensación: ceder algo para ganar otra cosa.
entries.example: Working shorter hours is a trade-off between income and free time.

entries.meaning: Deliberado, intencional; también deliberar (pensar con cuidado).
entries.example: The decision was slow but deliberate.

entries.meaning: Dar largas, postergar una decisión.
entries.example: He stalled until the deadline solved the problem for him.

entries.meaning: Prematuro: hecho antes del momento adecuado.
entries.example: Closing the file this early feels premature.

entries.meaning: Convincente, atractivo (un argumento, una idea).
entries.example: Her summary was short and compelling.

entries.meaning: Insignificante: tan pequeño que no cambia el resultado.
entries.example: The difference between the two estimates was negligible.

entries.meaning: Valor atípico: un dato muy alejado del resto.
entries.example: One outlier pulled the average up.

entries.meaning: Sesgar, distorsionar un resultado.
entries.example: A small sample can skew the whole comparison.

entries.meaning: Tamaño de la muestra: cantidad de casos observados.
entries.example: With such a small sample size, the ranking means little.

entries.meaning: Umbral: límite a partir del cual algo cambia.
entries.example: Sales crossed the threshold we had set for the quarter.

entries.meaning: Empujar suavemente; influir de forma sutil.
entries.example: A plain reminder nudged people to finish the survey.

entries.meaning: Corazonada, intuición visceral.
entries.example: My gut feeling said the numbers were too neat.

entries.meaning: Cuestionar una decisión ya tomada, revisarla de más.
entries.example: Stop second-guessing every choice you make.

entries.meaning: Accidental, secundario: no es lo principal.
entries.example: The extra cost was incidental to the plan.

entries.meaning: Llevar registro de algo, no perderle la pista.
entries.example: I keep track of new words in a single notebook.

entries.meaning: Aplazar, dejar algo para después.
entries.example: Reading one card at a time is easier than putting it off entirely.
